extension.description: A netrunner look in calm cyan with pink accents: cut corners, glitch titles and big artwork, with online movie and TV data from TMDb Helper.
extension.news: 0.4.49 - First public release. A calm cyberpunk skin for Kodi 21 with configurable home, movies and shows pages, info pages that walk top down, endless cast and crew navigation through TMDb Helper, a search page, a quick menu with clock, weather and power, and a player with track panels, chapter row and cast row.
